messages.author: c9bfdfa65734531d
messages.subject: Fwd: No taxon labels on plots
parts: Hi, I'm running just a basic DEC model on some data, and it keeps producing plots for me, but for some reason won't put the taxon labels on the text and pie plots. I've never had this problem before with BioGeoBEARS, and used scripts and files I modified from other, successful runs. I figure I must have made a mistake somewhere when making the modifications, but I can't find it. Anyone know what would cause this? My files are attached. Thanks!

messages.author: 115d05260b0c341a
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Fwd: No taxon labels on plots
parts:
Hi-on my phone, but likely the labels are getting printed, just off the edge of the PDF. An update to APE awhile back made the default printing of tip labels in a good place less reliable (in my experience).

Try :
Changing the size of the pdf
Changing tipcex 
xlim 
And there is an option in the plot_BioGeobears function for changing the space between the tip and the tip label, I forget the name...cheers! Nick

messages.author: 115d05260b0c341a
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Fwd: No taxon labels on plots
parts:
You might have turned off the tip labels with some option, if you compare to the example script command you might see a difference:

http://phylo.wikidot.com/biogeobears#script
=============
# States
res2 = plot_BioGeoBEARS_results(results_object, analysis_titletxt, addl_params=list("j"), plotwhat="text", label.offset=0.45, tipcex=0.7, statecex=0.7, splitcex=0.6, titlecex=0.8, plotsplits=TRUE, cornercoords_loc=scriptdir, include_null_range=TRUE, tr=tr, tipranges=tipranges)

# Pie chart
plot_BioGeoBEARS_results(results_object, analysis_titletxt, addl_params=list("j"), plotwhat="pie", label.offset=0.45, tipcex=0.7, statecex=0.7, splitcex=0.6, titlecex=0.8, plotsplits=TRUE, cornercoords_loc=scriptdir, include_null_range=TRUE, tr=tr, tipranges=tipranges)
=============

Cheers!
Nick
